  Scenario: AC13 Rules BR1 to BR10 applied as section 8 states
    Given the rules BR1 to BR10 of section 8 are in force
    When the step is taken
    Then each rule acts as its row in section 8 states
    Then no rule is applied as a branch or a constant of the build

  Scenario: AC14 Error answers of the provided operations (401, 403, 404)
    Given a request to a provided operation without a valid credential, from a caller out of scope, or for a claim not found
    When the operation is called
    Then the answer status is 401, 403 or 404 as the contract of the operation defines
    Then nothing is written

  Scenario: AC15 Replayed write with the same idempotency key
    Given a write of the claim already applied with an idempotency key
    When the same write is replayed with the same idempotency key
    Then the stored answer is returned
    Then no second position and no second decision record is written

  Scenario: AC16 Activity retry and timeout
    Given an activity of the step is retried or times out
    When the retry or the timeout occurs
    Then the retry writes no second position and no second decision record, as BR6 requires
    Then nothing is written from a timed-out attempt and the workflow keeps its durable state

  Scenario: AC17 Disallowed status change is refused
    Given a claim in a state from which the rule row in force does not allow the move
    When the step is taken
    Then the status is not changed and nothing is written
